# Spark Control Center 1.5.2

Driver log windows, draft object-storage folders and recursive prefix search.

## Driver logs

- Query Driver logs independently of the detail snapshot's 5000-line diagnostic tail. Choose latest logs or a specific line range and navigate previous/next ranges.
- Stream past earlier Kubernetes log lines without buffering the whole log. Each request is bounded to 10000 lines and 4 MiB; byte-limit warnings are explicit. Filtering keeps the original line numbers.
- Query retained Driver logs through Loki with a time range and oldest/newest order. Configure Alloy to collect `namespace`, `pod` and `spark_role="driver"`. Narrow the time range when Loki's per-query limit is reached.
- Offer an explicitly labeled saved diagnostic-tail fallback when live logs are unavailable. Kubernetes rotation/deletion cannot be undone by changing line ranges; logs must have been retained or ingested by Loki.
- Preserve namespace/tenant authorization and avoid auditing read-only log queries. Correct ordering of Loki timestamps with different fractional precision.

## Draft folders

- Add **New folder** for relative and nested directory paths in S3/MinIO and GCS.
- Keep empty folders in page memory only, with a Draft label and removal action. Do not create empty objects, directory markers or `.keep` files.
- Persist a prefix only after uploading an actual file or saving text beneath it. Unsaved directories disappear on page reload or root/account changes.
- Require list/upload permissions and a writable connection. Actual writes retain backend authorization, conditional-write protection and normal auditing; draft operations add no audit rows.

## Prefix search

- Search file names and relative paths under the current authorized prefix, including subfolders. Matching is case-insensitive; file contents and unsaved draft folders are excluded.
- S3/MinIO and GCS scan bounded metadata batches. Continue with Next even when a batch has no matches. Search cursors are bound to the user, tenant, grants, prefix and query.
- Searching does not download objects or add audit rows.

## Upgrade and validation

Back up PostgreSQL and update all three image tags to `1.5.2`. No new database migration or Helm setting is required. Existing GCS WIF, S3 credentials and directory grants are unchanged.

Validation covers frontend tests/build, Go tests/vet, PostgreSQL/MinIO regression, 12050-line Kubernetes fixtures and English desktop browser checks. CI removes duplicate Go runs and repeated frontend compilation; workflow SQL tests remain, while unrelated workflow container smoke tests are not repeated for this patch.

Release assets: `spark-control-center-1.5.2.tar`, `spark-control-center-backend-1.5.2.tar`, `spark-control-center-object-storage-1.5.2.tar` and `spark-control-center-1.5.2.tgz`. Image tags have no private registry prefix. No standalone checksum file is generated.
